data_fields.name: shrink_step_tiles
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per tick while at cap, not below 1

best_idea: Cap what each phone is sent with an adaptive radius (shrink while over the cap, grow one tile every 10 quiet ticks), nearest first, and carry over hit blocks that do not fit the byte budget instead of dropping them.
decision_why: Keep the cap, the adaptive radius and the byte budget; fix the grow step; nearest first at every radius; carry hits over. The donor silently drops hits, chat and anims when the packet is full, which would hide damage in a crowded fight. MIT allows adaptation.
acceptance: A server test with 60 enemies within 15 tiles of one phone client: the set holds at most the phone cap (zone data; 24 is a proposed design number), nearest first; the radius grows back one tile every 10 quiet ticks; a hit that does not fit the packet budget is delivered next tick, not lost.
